attributes.name: s-bind
attributes.description:
**Two-way data binding.** Connects an element to a store variable. Works with text, checkbox, radio, select, range, color, date, contenteditable, and display elements. ```html

Hello, {name}!

```

attributes.name: s-text
attributes.description: **Safe text content.** Sets `textContent` from an expression. HTML is escaped. ```html ```

attributes.name: s-html
attributes.description:
**Raw HTML content.** Sets `innerHTML` from an expression. Only use with trusted content. ```html
```

attributes.name: s-if
attributes.description:
**Conditional rendering.** Shows or hides elements based on an expression. Preserves the element's original `display` value (flex, grid, inline, etc.). ```html
Welcome back!
{items.length} items
```

attributes.name: s-for
attributes.description:
**List rendering.** Iterates over arrays with keyed reconciliation. The loop variable and `index` (0-based) are available inside. ```html
{index + 1}. {item.name}
```

attributes.name: s-key
attributes.description:
**List item key.** Tells `s-for` how to identify each item for efficient DOM reconciliation. ```html
...
```

attributes.name: s-click
attributes.description:
**Click handler.** Executes an expression when clicked. Works inside `s-for` with loop variable access.

```html
<button s-click="count++">Increment</button>
<button s-click="tasks.removeWhere('id', t.id)">Delete</button>
```

attributes.name: s-unclick
attributes.description:
**Click outside handler.** Fires when a click occurs outside the element. Useful for closing dropdowns and modals. ```html
Menu
```

attributes.name: s-on
attributes.description:
**General event binding.** Format: `event.modifier: expression`. Multiple bindings separated by semicolons.

Modifiers: `.prevent`, `.stop`, `.enter`, `.escape`

```html
<input s-on="keydown.enter: submit()">
<form s-on="submit.prevent: handleSubmit()">
```

attributes.name: s-class
attributes.description:
**Conditional CSS classes.** Semicolon-separated `className: expression` pairs. ```html
...
```

attributes.name: s-css
attributes.description:
**Dynamic inline styles.** Semicolon-separated `property: expression` pairs. Supports `{template}` expressions. ```html
...
```

attributes.name: s-attr
attributes.description:
**Dynamic HTML attributes.** Semicolon-separated `attribute: expression` pairs. `false`/`null`/`undefined` removes the attribute.

```html
<button s-attr="disabled: !formValid">Submit</button>
```

attributes.name: s-ref
attributes.description:
**Element reference.** Names an element for access via `$refs.name` in expressions.

```html
<input s-ref="myInput">
<button s-click="$refs.myInput.focus()">Focus</button>
```

attributes.name: s-cloak
attributes.description:
**Hide until ready.** Prevents flash of unprocessed `{template}` expressions. Removed automatically after init.

```html
<body s-cloak>...</body>
```

attributes.name: s-data
attributes.description:
**Inline variable definition.** Define reactive variables directly in HTML without a store. ```html
```

attributes.name: s-debounce
attributes.description:
**Debounced input.** Delays updates on text inputs until typing stops. Value in milliseconds.

```html
<input s-bind="search" s-debounce="300">
```

attributes.name: s-blur
attributes.description:
**Update on blur.** Switches text input binding from `keyup` to `blur` event.

```html
<input s-bind="tagline" s-blur>
```

attributes.name: s-transition
attributes.description:
**CSS transition animations.** Animate `s-if` show/hide and `s-for` enter/leave. Applies CSS class lifecycle: `{name}-enter` → `{name}-enter-active` → `{name}-enter-to`. ```html
Animated
```

attributes.name: s-src
attributes.description: **Dynamic image source.** For images inside `s-for` loops. Uses template syntax. ```html ```
